content.short: Analytics, automation and lending for liquidity providers on Uniswap and other AMMs.
content.description: Revert shows each LP position in detail, with liquidity, price and fee charts, uncollected fees, divergence PnL and ROI in one panel, and lets users filter every pool by APR, TVL and volume before creating a position. It supports Uniswap v2 to v4, SushiSwap, Aerodrome, PancakeSwap and Ekubo. Automation handles range management, and Revert Lend lets LPs borrow against their positions.
content.meta: Revert gives AMM liquidity providers detailed position analytics, pool discovery, automation and lending.
